integrity: Exact equations, domains and critical constants are contained in RESULT.md; verify.py checks identities and finite representative trajectories only, not universal infinite-time claims.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the exact planar, positive-parameter fear–refuge model with strictly positive initial populations. It does not treat stochastic, spatial, delayed, or zero-interference variants. General historical priority has not been independently established.
title: Global threshold dynamics and universal critical extinction in a fear–refuge predator–prey flow
